Frame: x=(lon+117.919)*92525 m east, y=(lat-33.8121)*110940 m north. Geography, footprints and place names only; names label places the way a map does. No Disney imagery, characters, logos or attraction artwork. Land names are as mapped in OSM (e.g. Critter Country is mapped as Bayou Country, its 2024 name). Building heights: OSM height/levels where tagged; Main Street U.S.A. untagged buildings default to 9 m (2-3 storey forced perspective); other untagged heights are defaults (see hd=1).
